name: QA Accuracy (example)
description: Minimal rubric for QA evaluation: was the answer correct, and was the model's self-reported confidence calibrated?

criteria.label: Answer is correct
criteria.description: Does the model's answer match the reference (allowing trivial wording differences)?

criteria.label: Confidence is calibrated
criteria.description: 1 = wildly off (confident but wrong / uncertain but correct). 5 = confidence matches actual correctness.
